assertions.name: yekutieli_correction_halves_family_A_codata_gap
assertions.source: Yekutieli per-cell curvature correction (-G·h²) added to Family A's leading 5/2 + (3/4)h² gives ~951 MeV m_p; framework gap to CODATA is halved from ~3 % to ~1.4 %. Passes iff the numerical relationship between the two predictions is as expected from the structural sum.

description: Strategy I (Yekutieli per-cell curvature): framework's honest substrate-pure prediction λ_scale^Yekutieli = 5/2 + (3/4 - G)·h² = 2.49266 at q_0. CATEGORICAL SUM of Family A (proved theorem, PR #701 / production #895) + Yekutieli per-cell curvature (-G, load-bearing categorical-bijection conjecture per audit docs/audits/2026-05-18-conjecture-proof-step3-yekutieli.md). Framework m_p prediction with Yekutieli correction = ~951 MeV; framework gap halved from ~3 % (Family A alone) to ~1.4 %. The alternative 'Reading A' = 5/2 - G·h² (Yekutieli REPLACES Wedderburn h²) was removed per user direction 2026-05-22 ("framework B only, remove A") — Reading A lands in the same 5.6 ppm coincidence basin PR #701 falsified for Wedderburn sums and treating it as the framework's prediction would conflict with Family A's proved theorem at h² order.

data.framework_prediction: λ_scale^Yekutieli = 5/2 + (3/4 − G)·h² + O(h⁴); m_p ≈ 951 MeV at q_0; framework gap to CODATA reduced from ~3 % (Family A alone) to ~1.4 %.
data.load_bearing_step: Cell-↔-half-sym-projection bijection at H_4 (audit §Concrete next R&D #1). Categorical theory work; with proof, λ_scale^Yekutieli becomes the framework's substrate-pure theorem.
